features.name: l2_norm_all_features
features.description: L2 norm of all 7 features, representing the overall magnitude of the feature vector in normalized space
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a scale-normalized distance from origin, helping KNN identify outlier rows and improving neighborhood geometry
features.formula: np.sqrt(date**2 + period**2 + nswprice**2 + nswdemand**2 + vicprice**2 + vicdemand**2 + transfer**2)

features.name: price_demand_ratio_nsw
features.description: Ratio of NSW price to NSW demand, capturing the price-per-unit-demand relationship in New South Wales
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-linear price-demand interaction that improves distance calculations in KNN by encoding economic state

features.name: price_demand_ratio_vic
features.description: Ratio of Victoria price to Victoria demand, capturing the price-per-unit-demand relationship in Victoria
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures Victoria-specific economic state as a normalized ratio, improving KNN distance sensitivity to price-demand dynamics

features.name: nsw_vic_price_diff
features.description: Absolute difference between NSW and Victoria prices, measuring inter-state price divergence
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes inter-state price divergence as a single distance-like feature, improving KNN neighborhood separation

features.name: nsw_vic_demand_diff
features.description: Absolute difference between NSW and Victoria demand levels, measuring inter-state demand divergence
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures demand imbalance between states as a normalized distance feature, aiding KNN in identifying similar market conditions

features.name: transfer_demand_balance
features.description: Difference between transfer and average of NSW and Victoria demand, indicating whether transfer compensates for demand imbalance
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes the relationship between inter-state transfer and average demand, providing a meaningful economic signal for KNN distance

features.name: period_sin_encoding
features.description: Sine encoding of the period feature to capture cyclical time-of-day patterns in a continuous circular space
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms periodic time feature into circular space, ensuring KNN distances correctly reflect temporal proximity across period boundaries

features.name: high_price_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for whether NSW price exceeds its training mean (0.0599), flagging high-price periods
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a cluster indicator that groups rows by price regime, helping KNN identify neighbors in similar market states

features.name: high_demand_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for whether NSW demand exceeds its training mean (0.4336), flagging high-demand periods
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a demand-regime cluster indicator, improving KNN neighborhood purity by grouping similar demand states

features.name: price_zscore_nsw
features.description: Z-score normalized NSW price using training mean (0.0599) and std (0.0421), measuring deviation from typical price
features.expected_model_benefit: Scale-normalized price deviation improves KNN distance calculations by standardizing the price dimension relative to training distribution

features.name: demand_zscore_nsw
features.description: Z-score normalized NSW demand using training mean (0.4336) and std (0.1613), measuring deviation from typical demand
features.expected_model_benefit: Scale-normalized demand deviation ensures KNN treats demand variation proportionally to its training distribution spread

features.name: market_stress_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall market stress combining high price, high demand, and large inter-state transfer relative to typical conditions. Score reflects how unusual the combination of price, demand, and transfer values is compared to typical operating ranges, with higher scores indicating more stressed or anomalous market conditions that may cluster differently in KNN space.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic market stress signal that captures complex multi-feature interactions, helping KNN identify anomalous market states that form distinct neighborhoods
